## Observed issue

Select the closest category: dead link; moved canonical source; archived or superseded project; unofficial fork; incorrect citation; access/rate-limit problem; misleading status; other.

## Evidence

Describe the observed result and provide a canonical replacement or upstream status notice when available. A timeout, login wall, or HTTP 429 is not automatically proof that a link is dead.

## Proposed correction

Provide the corrected URL, revised status label, source citation, or wording. Include the date you checked it.
